// Moore FSM, onehot state encoding
module TopModule(
    input  clk,
    input  reset,
    input  in,
    output reg out
);
    reg [1:0] state, next_state;
    always @(*) begin
        case (state)
            2'b00: begin out = 1'b0; next_state = in ? 2'b10 : 2'b00; end
            2'b01: begin out = 1'b0; next_state = in ? 2'b00 : 2'b01; end
            2'b10: begin out = 1'b0; next_state = in ? 2'b11 : 2'b00; end
            2'b11: begin out = 1'b1; next_state = in ? 2'b01 : 2'b01; end
        endcase
    end
    always @(posedge clk) begin
        if (reset) state <= 2'b00;
        else state <= next_state;
    end
endmodule

    input  in,
    output reg out,
    output reg A, B, C, D

            2'b10: begin next_state = in ? 2'b11 : 2'b01; out = 1'b0; end

        endcase

    always @(posedge clk) begin

        else begin state <= next_state; A <= (state == 2'b00); B <= (state == 2'b01); C <= (state == 2'b10); D <= (state == 2'b11); end
    end
endmodule
